q: Which electrical component is used to control the brightness of street lamps? (2026)
e: An LDR (Light Dependent Resistor) is used to control street light brightness based on ambient light level.

q: What is the main function of NOT gate in digital logic? (2026)
e: A NOT gate acts as an inverter, reversing the binary state of its input.

q: What is the output of XNOR gate if both inputs are the same? (2026)
e: An XNOR gate produces a high output (1) when all its inputs are identical.

q: _____ is used to control the brightness of the night lamp. (2025)
e: An LDR controls night lamp brightness by sensing ambient light levels.

q: A photodiode converts _____ into electrical current. (2026)
e: A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts light energy into electrical current.

q: There are _____ types of reverse breakdown regions in a zener diode. (2026)
e: Zener diodes experience two reverse breakdown mechanisms: avalanche breakdown and Zener breakdown.

q: What semiconductor device that converts light into electrical current? (2026)
e: Photodiodes convert light directly into electrical current when operating under reverse bias.

q: The photodiode can be used as a photodetector to detect the _____ signals. (2026)
e: Photodiodes are used as photodetectors to sense optical (light) signals.

q: The OR gate with inverted output is called a _____ gate. (2025)
e: A NOR gate is a combination of an OR gate followed by an inverter (NOT gate).

q: A photodiode converts _____ into electrical current. (2025)
e: Photodiodes convert incident light into electric current.

q: What should be the biasing of the LED? (2025)
e: An LED must be forward biased so that electron-hole recombination can emit light.

q: A _____ is a device that transforms a signal from one energy form to another energy form. (2025)
e: A transducer converts signals from one physical form of energy into another.

q: What is the primary application of a Zener diode? (2025)
e: Zener diodes maintain a constant voltage when operating in reverse breakdown, making them voltage regulators.

q: In _____ modulation the amplitude of carrier wave remains constant with modulation. (2025)
e: In frequency modulation (FM), the amplitude of the carrier wave stays constant while its frequency varies.

q: _____ gate produces a '1' when both inputs match. (2025)
e: An XNOR gate outputs logic 1 when all input values match.

q: What happens to the resistance of an LDR as the light intensity increases? (2025)
e: As light intensity increases, more charge carriers are generated in an LDR, decreasing its resistance.

q: As light level increases, the LDR resistance _____. (2025)
e: Increasing light level generates more electron-hole pairs, reducing the LDR's resistance.

q: A _____ is a semiconductor light source that emits light when current flows through it. (2025)
e: A Light Emitting Diode (LED) emits light when an electric current flows through it in forward bias.

q: What are the fundamental building blocks of digital ICs? (2025)
e: Logic gates are the basic building blocks used to construct digital integrated circuits (ICs).

q: Which gate produces a high output when one and only one of its inputs is high? (2025)
e: An XOR (Exclusive OR) gate yields a high output (1) only when its inputs are different.

q: Radio and television are examples of _____ mode of communication. (2025)
e: Radio and television transmit signals from a single transmitter to many receivers in broadcast mode.

q: _____ is a device which produces a measurable response due to a change in physical conditions. (2025)
e: A sensor detects changes in physical conditions and produces a measurable output signal.

q: By using basic rules of Boolean algebra, the output of (A · 0) and (A · A) is equal to _____ (2021)
e: In Boolean algebra, A · 0 = 0 and A · A = A.

q: In the Negative Temperature Coefficient (NTC) thermistor, the resistance _____ as the temperature increases. (2025)
e: For an NTC thermistor, resistance decreases as temperature increases.

q: A _____ is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal (or) vice versa. (2025)
e: A transducer converts non-electrical quantities into electrical signals or vice versa.

q: The fire alarm system consists of two logic gates, OR gate and _____. (2025)
e: A basic fire alarm control circuit uses an OR gate and an AND gate.

q: LDR consists of a disc of _____ material on its surface with two electrodes. (2026)
e: An LDR is made of photoconductive semiconductor material deposited on an insulating substrate.

q: LEDs do not directly produce _____ light. (2026)
e: LEDs emit light at specific narrow wavelengths and do not directly produce white light.

q: Which of the following is NOT listed as one of the six main pieces that comprise a radio receiver? (2026)
e: A frequency modulator belongs to a transmitter circuit rather than a receiver.
